# Warden SOP This is the list of procedures, responsibilities, and duties of the [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color] of this station.
For the purposes of Alert Escalation: Treat higher alerts as if they are still on the previous alert level. (Yellow Alert is Blue Alert if it was Blue Alert prior.) Furthermore, treat Delta, Gamma, and Violet Alert as Red Alert.
The [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color] is [bold]ALWAYS REQUIRED[/bold] to remain in the [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] department at all times unless the situation requires otherwise beyond a reasonable doubt!
## Green Alert
1. The Warden is permitted to carry a standard disabler, a stun baton, one flash, one flashbang, and their provided unique gloves and weapon selector.
2. The Warden is expected to spend their time performing each of the following tasks: - Monitor the status of the Armory and the [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] department as a whole. - Monitor prisoner health and safety and ensure no escapes have taken place. - Monitor the rest of the station via the camera network.
3. The Warden is to provide cohesion for [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] forces alongside the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Security[/bold][/color] and [color=#ba292c][bold]Sergeant[/bold][/color]. This includes providing decision-making in place of the Head of Security if understaffed or if an emergency situation requires such.
4. The Warden must conduct a thorough search of every prisoner's belongings, including carried bags or toolbelts, pockets, coat storage, etc. Following proper Space Law, all non-contraband belongings are to be returned when the search is finished unless tampering is evident. Replacements should be issued as quickly as possible.
5. The Warden must ensure that all prisoners are equipped with their PDA, headset, and clothes (provided they are not contraband/tampered with). In such cases where the PDA, headset, and/or clothes are tampered with, replacements should be issued.
6. The Warden is not obligated to provide a legal trial but should allow legal representation for Capital Crimes if the suspect requests it.
7. The Warden [bold]cannot[/bold] hand out any weapons or armor from the Armory. This also includes giving away their unique gear to either the Head of Security or [color=#ba292c][bold]Security Officers[/bold][/color].
8. The Warden must read to every prisoner the crimes they are sentenced to.
9. The Warden is not permitted to leave prisoners buckled and cuffed to their beds. An exception is made if the prisoners are acting overly hostile or attempting to breach the cell in order to escape.
10. The Warden must follow the same guidelines as Security Officers for attire, though clothing made for Wardens is also appropriate to wear.
11. The Warden, the Head of Security, and the Sergeant are the [bold]ONLY[/bold] members of Security allowed inside the Armory. The Armory must [bold]NEVER[/bold] be left on emergency access.
## Blue Alert
1. All Guidelines except Guidelines 1, 7, and 11 carry over from [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color].
2. The Warden is permitted to hand out equipment from the Armory. Energy and Laser weapons are only to be handed out with the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Captain[/bold][/color] and/or the Head of Security's approval and when applicable to current station threats. This approval may be bypassed if there is a lethal threat and/or emergency that requires their use.
3. If arming procedures are in effect, the Warden is expected to [bold]closely[/bold] observe to ensure [bold]ALL[/bold] arms are returned when alert level decreases. The Armory must [bold]NEVER[/bold] be left on emergency access if the Warden is not [bold]directly[/bold] observing the arming procedure.
## Red Alert
1. All Guidelines except Guidelines 1, 7, 10, and 11 carry over from [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color]. All Guidelines except Guideline 1 are carried over from [color=#1b67a5]Blue Alert[/color].
2. The Warden may also carry any weapon from the Armory. However, Security Officers are to be armed before the Warden is to take additional weaponry.
3. The Warden is permitted to distribute any weapon or piece of equipment in the Armory. This includes whatever Research has provided.
4. The Armory may be left on emergency access [bold]ONLY[/bold] if the emergency situation requires this beyond a reasonable doubt. If the Armory must be left on emergency access unobserved, the Warden is expected to remove the emergency access status from the armoury [bold]as soon as the situation allows[/bold].
5. The Warden, with approval from Captain and/or Head of Security, may allow each Head of Staff to possess one (1) sidearm. This may only occur if all present Security personnel have been allowed to fully arm themselves. The lethal weapon must be returned when the alert is reduced.
6. In the unlikely event that crew is informed to take up arms, the Warden must ensure all Security personnel have armed first. The Warden is to directly monitor which crewmember takes which firearm, and they are to [bold]ENSURE[/bold] that all arms are returned as quickly as the situation allows.
